card.line: Hobah was a region north of Damascus, the farthest point to which Abram chased the enemy kings after they captured his relative Lot.

moments.title: Abram chases the kings to Hobah
moments.text: Abram divided his forces at night and routed Chedorlaomer's army. He pursued them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus, and brought back Lot and all the goods.
